_quiz_pool.question: What does rho represent in the pressure formula?
What is the SI unit of pressure P?
If water depth doubles, what happens to hydrostatic pressure?
_quiz_pool.explanation: Pressure grows in direct proportion to depth.

_quiz_pool.question: What causes hydrostatic pressure in standing water?
options: The weight of the water above
_quiz_pool.explanation: Gravity pulls down on the water mass, creating downward force.

_quiz_pool.question: 1,000 kg/m³ is the density of...
_quiz_pool.explanation: Standard fresh water has a density of 1,000 kg/m³.

_quiz_pool.question: What is g in physics equations on Earth?
_quiz_pool.explanation: g is acceleration due to gravity, roughly 9.81 m/s².

_quiz_pool.question: Why are lower parts of flood barriers built thicker?
_quiz_pool.explanation: Pressure is greatest at the bottom, requiring stronger support.

_quiz_pool.question: Which agency monitors weather in Indonesia?
_quiz_pool.explanation: BMKG is Indonesia's meteorology and geophysics agency.

_quiz_pool.question: Rainwater flowing over the land surface is called...
_quiz_pool.explanation: Runoff is water that flows over the ground into drains.

_quiz_pool.question: A pascal is equal to...
_quiz_pool.explanation: One pascal equals one newton per square meter.

cover.title: Why flood water pushes hard
cover.subtitle: Heavy monsoon rains raise river levels. Discover why even shallow flood water has strong pressure and how communities prepare.

quest.1.desc: Read about monsoon rains and floods

cover.fun_fact: Water pressure grows steadily with depth, making deep water very heavy to push against.
story.title: Heavy rains and rising waters
story.lead: Weather forecasters warned of heavy monsoon rainfall across Indonesia [1]. Rising river waters and blocked drains can cause flash floods in towns [2].
stat.1.label: kg/m³ density of pure water
stat.2.label: m/s² acceleration due to gravity
stat.3.label: pascal pressure at 50 cm depth
story.body_1: Monsoon season brings intense storms to Southeast Asia. When rain falls faster than soil and drains can absorb it, water accumulates on streets [1]. Moving flood water has massive weight and pressure [2].
story.body_2: Meteorological agencies track weather patterns to issue early warnings [3]. Knowing how water pressure works helps engineers build stronger barriers and keep families safe.
timeline.1.text: Heavy clouds release intense rainfall over river basins.
timeline.2.text: Rainwater flows rapidly down slopes and fills urban drains.
timeline.3.text: Overflowing water creates flood layers across streets.
physics.title: Pressure in liquids
physics.body_1: Liquids have weight. When water collects in a layer, it presses down on everything underneath it. The deeper the water gets, the greater the pressure becomes.
physics.body_2: Hydrostatic pressure depends on fluid density, gravity, and depth. Even a small rise in water level increases the force pushing against walls and doors.
physics.assumptions: We assume water density is uniform and ignore atmospheric pressure.
table.note: Pressure increases directly with water depth.

lab.title: Water depth and pressure test
lab.step_1: Fill a tall plastic bottle with water up to a measured height.
lab.step_2: Poke small holes at different heights down the side of the bottle.
lab.step_3: Observe how far water squirts out from the lower holes compared to upper holes.
lab.question: Why does water squirt further from holes lower down on the bottle?
